```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(respondersig)
```

# Read in data
```{r}
load("../../data/clinical.rds")
load("../../data/microbiome_metadata.rds")
load("../../data/respondersig-input.rds")
```

# Format
```{r}
baseline <- mic.meta %>%
  group_by(`Patient Id`) %>%
  arrange(Days) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(abs(Days) <= 10)

samp.info <- mic.meta %>%
  left_join(demographics) %>%
  select(sample, irAE) %>%
  mutate(response = ifelse(irAE == "Yes", "irAE", "No irAE")) %>%
  filter(sample %in% taxa$sample,
         # remove problematic outlier
         sample != "FF08034405") %>%
  select(-irAE)

samp.info.base <- samp.info %>%
  filter(sample %in% baseline$sample)

taxa <- taxa %>% filter(sample %in% samp.info$sample)
taxa.base <- taxa %>% filter(sample %in% baseline$sample)
```

# Try respondersig function
```{r}
#rsig <- respondersig::prep_input(tax = taxa, meta = samp.info)
rsig.baseline <- respondersig::prep_input(tax = taxa.base, meta = samp.info.base)
```

```{r}
save(rsig.baseline, file = "../../data/respondersig-irae-baseline.rds")
```
